title: Invenbill — retail billing
status: Live in a Chennai retail shop
description: A desktop billing and inventory tool built around a real shop’s daily workflow.
sections: A local retailer needed checkout, invoicing, inventory, and sales tracking in one desktop workflow.
Worked directly with the store owner to gather requirements, incorporate feedback, and iteratively refine the user experience. Built and maintained the application for the shop.

An offline-first SQLite database keeps billing available without a network connection. Product codes support quick access at checkout; GST calculations and printable invoices reduce repetitive manual work.
Billing with line items and notes; catalogue and inventory management; revenue, profit, and expense dashboards; expense logging; and PDF invoice export.
Used for 50+ daily transactions, as documented in my resume. The application is actively used in a retail shop in Chennai.
Local storage supports offline operation and simple migration by copying billing.db. Backups remain a responsibility of the local installation.
